name: workflow-visualizer
description: Live console for agentic work: the orchestrator and every agent as servers in a rack (status, what they are doing, tokens, cost), plus the loop-mode orchestration skill and delivery metrics from your repo's ADRs, specs and tickets.

language.title: Conversation language
language.description: Conversation language for the visualizer UI and its orchestration prompts (code and docs stay in English).

autonomy.title: Default decision mode
autonomy.description: Default decision mode for loop runs: 'hitl' pauses before push/PR/merge and asks; 'autonomous' proceeds and reports.

jiraProject.title: Jira project key
jiraProject.description: Project key (e.g. MH) whose open sprint feeds the objectives metrics; empty disables sprint metrics.

jiraPointsField.title: Jira story points field
jiraPointsField.description: Custom field id holding story points (commonly customfield_10016).

jiraServer.title: Atlassian MCP server
jiraServer.description: Name of the connected Atlassian MCP server as /mcp lists it.
